comment: Params 0 (clock division), 6 (purge) and 7 (drive) exist in the code but have no control on the panel; drive stays at its default of 1, so the output is not scaled. The five CV jacks multiply their knob rather than adding to it (Satanonaut.hpp:92): at 0V the knob is ignored and the parameter reads zero, and the knob sets how far 10V can push it. With no cable the knob is used on its own.
